messages:
Anya Patel: Hey product/design — dropping a quick Figma link for the API Keys page iteration. Focus: create/rotate/revoke flows, permission labels, warning tone, and empty-state CTAs. Comments by EOD? https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/keys-ops

Devon Kim: Skimmed it, quick notes: for create modal — change primary CTA from "Create" to "Generate key" (clearer). Add inline hint under secret: "This secret is shown once. Copy now or you won't be able to see it again." :warning:

Liam Martinez: a11y: ensure the secret reveal button is keyboard focusable and has aria-pressed. Also check contrast for the red danger banner on rotate/revoke — current color fails our threshold (~3.9:1). Needs 4.5:1 or add icon + stronger text treatment.

Sara O'Neill: Copy nit: current revoke modal says "This will disable the key" — sounds passive. Suggest: "Revoking this key immediately removes access for any apps using it." CTA: primary should be "Revoke key" (danger) and secondary "Cancel". Add a checkbox: "I understand this cannot be undone" only for org-admin role.

Devon Kim: Permission UI: replace verbatim "Owner/Editor/Viewer" with "Full access / Read + Manage / Read-only" — slightly clearer for non-technical users. Also add role hint: "Keys inherit app scopes — check app settings to see what each key can access." small helper text.

design-bot: Automated checklist: contrast check failing for .warning-banner (ratio 3.7), missing focus outline on .secret-toggle, missing aria-label on revoke confirm button. Reference: https://redwood.internal/a11y-checks/keys

Liam Martinez: For empty state: keep copy short. Proposal:

"No API keys yet"
"Generate an API key to integrate Redwood Inference with your app. Secrets are shown once — treat them like passwords."

Primary CTA: `Generate API key`  Secondary: `Learn more about keys`

Anya Patel: Love these. Decisions: 1) Update create CTA to "Generate API key" and inline secret copy. 2) Revoke modal copy updated to Sara's wording + add admin-only irreversible checkbox. 3) Update role labels per Devon. 4) Design to fix color contrast and add focus outline. 5) Add ephemeral toast when copy happens: "Secret copied — this is shown once" with aria-live. I'll update the Figma and create a PR with copy and acceptance criteria.

Devon Kim: Quick microcopy for the revoke modal (feel free to reuse):

"Revoking this key will immediately cut access for any apps using it. This action cannot be undone."

Buttons: `[Revoke key] [Cancel]`

Sara O'Neill: small accessibility nits: trap focus inside modal, set initial focus to destructive button with aria-describedby pointing to irreversible text so screen readers announce danger. Also ensure the toast uses polite/assertive aria-live appropriately.

Anya Patel: Good call. We'll set focus to the destructive button and add aria-describedby pointing to the irreversible text. Thanks all — syncing with eng tomorrow to get front-end acceptance tests. :rocket:

Devon Kim: /remind @Devon to follow up after PR merges in 3 days

design-bot: Reminder set: 3 days

Anya Patel: marking this thread resolved — moving checklist to the ticket: INF-4321
